scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter backend run dev" "pnpm --filter frontend run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend run build && pnpm --filter frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend run typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend run type-check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend run test && pnpm --filter frontend run test
